body.description: Hermana Lupe, an elderly woman who says the town's rites: short silver-white hair, plain white blouse with a navy collar band, long dark skirt, a wooden rosary at her wrist, calm stern face. a person of a small South Texas border town generations after the sky turned white, sun-faded patched clothes, dust on the boots
body.style_description: modern indie action-adventure pixel art: chunky stylized proportions, big bold readable silhouette, saturated colours, lineless with strong graphic light and shadow shapes, expressive and punchy
